description: A single filled area drawn as steps, holding each value flat until the next reading.
overview: Uses `AreaChart` with one `Area` set to `type="step"`, a dashed horizontal `CartesianGrid`, and an `XAxis` on `month` abbreviated to three letters. `chartData` holds six months of `{ month, desktop, mobile }` records; only `desktop` is drawn with `chartConfig.desktop` (`var(--blue)`) at `fillOpacity={0.18}`. The tooltip uses `indicator="line"`.
usage: Replace `chartData` with readings that change in discrete jumps, such as prices, plan tiers or counts. Keep the `month` and `desktop` keys or rename them along with `chartConfig`. Recharts also accepts `"stepBefore"` and `"stepAfter"` for `type` if you need the step to occur at a different point.
notes: `accessibilityLayer` is set on the chart, so the plot is focusable and arrow keys move the tooltip between months.
